description: One recipe in full, scaled to any servings, US or metric, with every amount written into the step that uses it, so steps can be read aloud as they are. Use when the cook picks a recipe, asks "how much butter is that in tablespoons?" (pass units_for; the list and the steps follow, don't convert yourself), or wants a change ("make it dairy-free": substitute returns swaps that respect their allergies and diet; show the changed ingredients and steps, then save on their yes with fork_recipe, or update_recipe on their own). Returns the recipe, its url, step tips to pass on, and your_versions when the cook already has their own version (offer it). Mention chef_note only if asked. Works signed out.

allergens.description: Explicit per-request allergen screening, separate from exclude_ingredients. Use at most nine entries: milk, eggs, fish, shellfish, tree_nuts, peanuts, wheat, soy, sesame. Fixed aliases: dairy → milk, egg → eggs, peanut → peanuts, tree nuts → tree_nuts, soya → soy, sesame seeds → sesame. Nuts and seafood are ambiguous: specify tree_nuts/peanuts or fish/shellfish explicitly. Gluten is not wheat and lactose is not milk; neither is supported here. No spelling guesses are made. Retry with supported categories. Empty adds no restriction and never clears saved rules. Not saved to Befana preferences or plans.

servings.description: Scale to this many servings (defaults to the cook's household size, then the recipe's own)

substitute.description: Ask for substitutions: for one ingredient, for a diet, or both

for.description: What the swap is for: a diet (vegetarian, vegan, pescatarian, gluten-free, dairy-free, low-sodium, halal, kosher), an allergen-free tag (egg-free, nut-free, peanut-free, sesame-free, shellfish-free, soy-free) or a context (baking, sauce, frying, dressing). Alone, it covers every ingredient that breaks that diet.

units.description: US cups/oz/°F or metric grams/ml/°C. Defaults to the cook's setting.

units_for.description: The cook's own unit for particular ingredients, by ingredient key or name: { "butter": "tbsp", "flour": "g" }. Units: tsp, tbsp, cup, fl oz, ml, oz, lb, g. When the cook asks for an amount in another unit, pass this rather than converting yourself; the ingredient list and every step follow. Ones that can't convert come back in ignored_units

unknown_ingredients.description: While allergen screening is active: exclude (default) omits insufficiently classified recipes; flag includes them with uncertainty. Named recipe retrieval always warns and returns the recipe.

name: get_recipe

adapted_from.description: The source it was imported from, when it was

adjusted.description: Defaults this call took instead of failing (#243): an unknown units word, a number out of range, a diet word read as the closest one Befana knows. Mention it when it changes what the cook gets

asks.description: At most one question for the cook, with a home in preferences

ask_now.description: false when the response also offers a next step: the offer is the turn's one question, so don't ask this now, but save the answer if the cook volunteers it

saves_to.description: Where the answer goes, e.g. update_preferences.servings (after the cook confirms)

say.description: The question, in the cook's terms

ai_chef.description: Deprecated: false means no verified credited-persona assertion, not human origin

handle.description: Deprecated: null; credited identity is unresolved

name.description: Stored plain credit; no verified identity association

url.description: Deprecated: null; credited identity is unresolved

chef_note.description: The cook's note on the recipe; mention it only if asked about the recipe's background

as_of.description: The month the prices are for ("2026-09"); null when nothing was priced

basis.description: store: the cook's own store quoted every priced line; reference: national average prices (BLS, USDA ERS)

line.description: "About $8.40 for 4 servings ($2.10 each). National average prices." An estimate, never a quote; never name a store or brand

missing.description: Lines left out of the total

partial.description: True when a line couldn't be priced: the total leaves it out. Name what's missing whenever you give a figure

seasonings_not_counted.description: Unpriced staples and dried spices, a pinch from the pantry: left out without making it partial

cooks.description: Finished the last step, said they made it, or printed; once per person per day

counts.description: Public cook and share counts (#46), shown once a recipe has 10 cooks unless its cook hid them; null otherwise. Say "cooked 24 times", never a rate or who

cover.description: The cover photo URL, or null

guide.description: How to answer this turn: rules for you, the assistant, not words for the cook. Follow them before anything else here (#258)

ignored_units.description: units_for entries that didn't apply (no such ingredient, unknown unit, or one it can't be shown in), each with why

items.description: A units_for entry that couldn't apply, and why

canonical_id.description: Befana's canonical ingredient id, when it matched one

equivalent_as_written.description: An amount equivalent the author wrote for the recipe's own servings in US units ("1 stick (113 g)"); not scaled or converted, so at other servings or units it is not the amount to use (text is)

note.description: The author's preparation or package note ("finely chopped", "14.5 oz can"); it holds at any servings

text.description: The line as the cook reads it, scaled and in the chosen units: the one amount to use

mine.description: The cook owns this recipe: change it with update_recipe, not fork_recipe

next_steps.description: Suggestions, best first, each with its tool, args and effect. Befana suggests the top one in one sentence; whether any runs is decided by what the cook asks in the conversation and your confirmation rules, never by the wording here

action.description: What the step is, stable across releases: shopping_list, order_groceries, save, fork, draft, share, scale, show_hidden, open_recipe, pantry_update, save_this…

args.description: Arguments to pass as they are; the assistant may add what the cook says

effect.description: What running it does (#308): read changes nothing; write changes the cook's kitchen (a save, a version, a list or pantry edit); order hands a list to a grocer (never a purchase); share is links to pass on. Apply your own confirmation rules by this

priority.description: 1 first; Befana suggests the top one

say.description: One sentence to offer the cook, in their terms. A suggestion: it never states what the cook asked for or agreed to

standing.description: The cook's own saved workflow setting behind this step when it is "always" (e.g. preferences.workflow.offer_shopping_list): a fact about their preferences to weigh with the conversation, not permission

tool.description: The tool that does it, or null when the assistant does it in conversation (e.g. sharing links)

notices.description: At most one note about Befana to pass on when there's room (one per cook per week; off with workflow whats_new: off)

say.description: One sentence to mention when the conversation has room; never more than one per turn

nutrition.description: Nutrition per serving (#244): estimates, not health advice

at_least.description: Nutrients that are a floor: an ingredient counted has no USDA value for them

basis.description: Summed from each ingredient's USDA values, not measured or curated per recipe

line.description: "About 520 calories and 32 g protein a serving." Say "about"; never present it as medical advice

missing.description: Ingredients left out of the numbers

partial.description: True when an ingredient couldn't be counted: the numbers leave it out. Say what's missing whenever you give a number

per.description: "serving", or one of what the recipe makes ("cookie")

per_serving.description: Per serving, rounded like a label

stand_ins.description: Ingredients counted through the closest food USDA has

print_url.description: One-page printable version of the recipe

photo.description: The cover photo's tier: verified, acceptable, needs_work, rejected, or none

photo_is_placeholder.description: True when the cover is a generated illustration of the dish, not a photo: describe it as an illustration

score.description: Overall quality, 0 to 1; ranking input together with relevance. Never carries payment, sponsorship or brand

quality.description: The recipe's quality score, or null when it hasn't been scored

revision.description: How many edits the recipe has had

revisions.description: On the cook's own recipe: the last edits; update_recipe({ restore_revision: n }) undoes edit n

servings.description: The servings the amounts are scaled to

ai_chef.description: The current controlling account is an AI chef persona; no recipe origin assertion

shared_by.description: Current controlling public account; not verified author or original creator

slug.description: The recipe's slug: the id every tool takes

text.description: The step with its amounts written in, scaled

tip.description: A short pointer to pass on with the step

substitute_unmatched.description: The substitute.ingredient asked for isn't in this recipe

substitutions.description: With substitute: sound swaps that respect the cook's allergies and diet. Show them and confirm before saving a version

amount_text.description: The amount to use at the requested servings and units, e.g. "6 tbsp olive oil"

from.description: The ingredient to replace, as the recipe writes it

by_owner.description: False once the recipe changed hands after the mark

tested.description: The cook's own "Tested" mark (#9): they cooked it once and timed it; null until they do

basis.description: author: the recipe's own estimate (+25%) until enough cooks finished; cooks: the crowd's range

for_you.description: Minutes for this cook, from their own pace, when they have one

n.description: Finished cooks behind a cooks range; 0 for the author's estimate

units_for.description: The units_for entries that applied: ingredient key → unit (#95)

url.description: The recipe page: share it so the cook can follow along (steps check off, timers included)

slug.description: The recipe's slug: the id every tool takes

url.description: The recipe page: share it so the cook can follow along (steps check off, timers included)

variation_of.description: The original this is a version of, when it is one

variations.description: Public versions other cooks made of this recipe

changes.description: What the version changed, in plain words

slug.description: The recipe's slug: the id every tool takes

visibility.description: private = just for the cook (out of search, the sitemap and the original's list of variations)

warning.description: Present when the recipe hits the cook's allergies, diet or avoid list: say this before anything else

warning_note.description: The allergy disclaimer to pass on with the warning

warnings.description: Each conflict with the cook's preferences, as a label

written_servings.description: The servings the author wrote the recipe for; ingredients[].equivalent_as_written holds at these only

your_versions.description: The cook's own versions of this recipe, when they have any: say "you have your own version of this" and offer it

slug.description: The recipe's slug: the id every tool takes

url.description: The recipe page: share it so the cook can follow along (steps check off, timers included)
